synthesis:draft.headline: SA1 5-minute RRP peaked at 4981.0 $/MWh (interval end 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z = 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST).
summary: A 5-minute RRP peak of 4981.0 $/MWh was recorded for SA1 at the interval ending 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z (2026-07-31 02:05 ACST) (evidence: ev0436; ev0001).
The project analysis threshold was 300.0 $/MWh and 214 five-minute intervals in the window met-or-exceeded that threshold (evidence: ev0888; ev0002).
Total dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the 5-minute price peak was 1472.82 MW and net interchange at that 5-minute interval was -82.59 MW (net flow into SA1 / import) (evidence: ev0437; ev0438).
The peak half-hour (interval ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z) had RRP = 899.44 $/MWh (evidence: ev0451).

Operational (measured) demand for the half-hour containing the price extreme (half‑hour ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z) was 1466.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 2173.0 MW (evidence: ev0913; ev0898).

AEMO market notices retrieved for SA1 in the window include a City West transformer/circuit‑breaker trip notice and a short‑notice outage / inter-regional transfer limit variation for the Belalie–Davenport 275kV line; those notices are listed as published_findings below (citations c1, c2).
SCADA observations show several large unit output changes in the 15:00–18:00 UTC window (examples: BlythB change −59.57 MW, Barkips −45.81 MW, AGLHAL −38.97 MW) (evidence: ev0940; ev0943; ev0946).

numeric_claims.text: Number of five-minute intervals at-or-above threshold
Half-hour RRP for half‑hour ending 17:00 UTC
Operational demand in the half‑hour containing the price extreme (half‑hour ending 17:00 UTC)

possible_explanations.statement: A short‑notice outage of the Belalie–Davenport 275kV line (market notice c2) might have reduced interconnector transfer capability into SA1 and might be associated with higher prices around the 16:35 UTC spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve the invoked constraint set S-DVBL_BC-2CP equations and time series of interconnector limits and flows spanning 16:00–17:00 UTC to show a change in limit or available transfer, and compare constraint outputs to price and interchange changes (network outage scheduler and constraint logs).

possible_explanations.statement: Large reductions in observed unit outputs (SCADA) in the 15:00–18:00 UTC window (examples: BlythB, Barkips, AGLHAL) might have reduced available local supply margin and might be associated with upward price pressure around the peak (see SCADA evidence ev0940, ev0943, ev0946).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain participant bid/offer and rebid histories, formal unit outage records and dispatch targets for those DUIDs to determine whether the SCADA changes reflect forced outages, dispatch instructions, or bidding/operational decisions.

possible_explanations.statement: The earlier City West transformer/circuit‑breaker trip reported in market notice c1 might have influenced network security settings or constraints later in the day and might be related to the system state during the high‑price episode.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review network outage scheduler entries, constraint propagation logs and any subsequent constraint changes referencing the City West equipment between 11:40 NEM time and 16:30 NEM time to identify linkage between that earlier non‑credible contingency and later constraint settings.

citations.supports: reports a City West transformer/circuit‑breaker trip in SA1 on 30/07/2026

citations.quote: Inter-regional transfer limit variation - Belalie-Davenport 275kV line - SA region - 30/07/2026.
citations.supports: reports a short‑notice outage / inter-regional transfer limit variation for the Belalie–Davenport line on 30/07/2026

uncertainties: Generation_change tool provides descriptive SCADA observations only and does not identify whether changes were forced outages, dispatch instructions or bidding decisions (see ev0940, ev0943, ev0946).

Market notices report events but do not by themselves show how constraint equations changed or the quantitative limit reductions; constraint texts and network outage scheduler entries are needed to confirm effects on transfer capability.
missing_evidence: Constraint equation contents and network outage scheduler details for S-DVBL_BC-2CP and any constraint sets invoked at ~16:30 NEM time.
Time series of interconnector limits and flows with evidence ids spanning 15:30–17:30 UTC to show any change in available import capacity.
Participant bid/offer and rebid histories, and formal unit outage notices for DUIDs with large SCADA changes (e.g., BlythB, Barkips, AGLHAL).
AEMO constraint outputs or logs that map the short‑notice outage to specific limit/constraint changes.
